sources.resolution: RESOLVED IN PHASE 2, BY REPLACEMENT RATHER THAN BY RE-SOURCING. The stems this source was cited for - the lay-up reactivation question and the dry dock coordination question - are now evidenced by the Directorate General of Shipping's OWN published question bank, at a strictly higher provenance tier (BANK-015 and BANK-018). The RECURRENCE claims no longer depend on this source at all. What is NOT replaced is the DATE: the bank is undated, so the asserted July 2012 SITTING remains unevidenced and is not counted as an occurrence anywhere. The Phase-1 reading was also incomplete - the excerpt carried only the first sentence of the dry dock question, which is why Phase 1 wrongly concluded that two thirds of QP2608-Q2 had no ancestor.
